review: B2 in-house cuFFT ctypes binding (_cufft.py) adversarial correctness review (5 dimensions)

wrong_or_risky.item: __del__ does not make CUDA context current before cufftDestroy
wrong_or_risky.evidence: At interpreter shutdown pycuda.autoprimaryctx (imported at cuvarbase __init__) may be torn down before Plan.__del__ runs; cufftDestroy then operates with no current/valid context. try/except Exception catches Python errors only, NOT a C-level segfault inside libcufft. In practice cufftDestroy tolerates a torn-down context (returns an error / no-op), and the _lib-is-not-None guard prevents calling an unloaded lib, so this is a low-severity residual risk inherent to ctypes+CUDA finalizers, not a pointer/handle-type corruption bug. Normal (explicit-free) path is unaffected.
wrong_or_risky.fix: Optional hardening: in __del__, only call cufftDestroy if a CUDA context is still active, e.g. guard with a try around pycuda.driver.Context.get_current() (or a module-level _shutting_down flag set via atexit) and skip destroy when None; leaks at process exit are reclaimed by the OS anyway. Not required for correctness.

wrong_or_risky.item: Transitive deps of libcufft must resolve at dlopen (libcudart.so.12, libcublas, libcublasLt, libnvJitLink for CUDA 12)
wrong_or_risky.evidence: CDLL('libcufft.so.11') triggers the loader to resolve cuFFT's NEEDED entries. If cuFFT is present but a sibling (e.g. nvidia-cublas-cu12 / libnvJitLink) is not on the loader path, dlopen fails and the OSError surfaces as 'could not load libcufft ... Last error: <dep>.so: cannot open shared object' (_cufft.py:90-96) -- the message names the dependency, not cufft, which can mislead. Common in pip-only installs (nvidia-cufft-cu12 without all siblings) and in mixed-toolkit images.
wrong_or_risky.fix: Keep the broad except OSError but enrich the ImportError to hint at missing CUDA runtime siblings / LD_LIBRARY_PATH; optionally CDLL(name, mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL) so deps loaded by pycuda (libcudart) are visible. Not a blocker because the failure is loud and the pod path works.

wrong_or_risky.item: Dynamic loader search path for versioned SONAME (LD_LIBRARY_PATH)
wrong_or_risky.evidence: CDLL('libcufft.so.11') relies entirely on the dynamic loader: ld.so.cache/ldconfig dirs or LD_LIBRARY_PATH. On the RunPod CUDA 12.4 image libcufft.so.11 lives in /usr/local/cuda-12.4/lib64, which is NOT in the default ld.so.conf. The project's own harness works because scripts export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${CUDA_DIR}/lib64 before pytest (run-remote.sh:41, test-remote.sh:43, setup-remote.sh:46). An end user who pip-installs cuvarbase and imports it without setting LD_LIBRARY_PATH (and without a dev-package ldconfig entry) gets ImportError despite cuFFT being installed under the toolkit.
wrong_or_risky.fix: As a fallback, probe well-known toolkit dirs (glob /usr/local/cuda*/lib64/libcufft.so.* and the nvidia/cufft/lib site-packages dir from the pip wheel) and CDLL the absolute path; document that LD_LIBRARY_PATH must include CUDA lib64 for runtime-only installs.

wrong_or_risky.item: Candidate ordering / wrong-version risk when multiple toolkits coexist
wrong_or_risky.evidence: _cufft.py:80-82 tries unversioned 'libcufft.so' first, then .so.11, .so.10, .so.12; first successful CDLL wins (break at line 89). If a dev-package 'libcufft.so' symlink from a different toolkit is on the path it is preferred over the runtime .so.11 actually intended. On the single-toolkit CUDA 12.4 pod this is benign (only .so.11 resolves), but in mixed environments it can bind an unintended major version.
wrong_or_risky.fix: Prefer the loader's own resolution via find_library result first (already done), then order versioned SONAMEs by the detected CUDA major (e.g. from pycuda.driver.get_version()) instead of a fixed .so.11-before-.so.10/.12 list; or rely on LD_LIBRARY_PATH ordering and drop the unversioned-first preference.

verdict: 0 blockers, 0 wrong, 0 unsure. All ctypes signatures/constants/pointer-types/integration verified CORRECT vs the cuFFT C API. 4 minor RISKY findings, all in library DISCOVERY (not FFT correctness): __del__-at-shutdown, transitive-dep dlopen, LD_LIBRARY_PATH for versioned SONAME, mixed-toolkit version ordering.
resolution: Hardened _load(): glob pip-wheel (nvidia/cufft/lib) + CUDA toolkit lib64 dirs for absolute-path discovery, RTLD_GLOBAL, enriched ImportError. Added atexit _shutting_down guard so Plan.__del__ skips cufftDestroy during interpreter shutdown. Core binding correctness unchanged (was already correct).
